UPDATE durable.task
              SET state = 'ready',
                  wakeup_at = NULL,
                  running_on = (
                    SELECT id
                     FROM durable.worker
                    ORDER BY random() + task.id
                    LIMIT 1
                  )
            WHERE state = 'suspended'
              AND wakeup_at <= ($2::timestamptz - $1::interval)
